name: Circinus
introduction: is the Drawing Compass, introduced by Nicolas-Louis de Lacaille in the 1750s. It is a small constellation near Alpha Centauri.

sections.title: What makes it special
paragraphs: The Circinus Galaxy, a spiral galaxy with an active nucleus, lies behind the Milky Way. The remnant of SN 185, the earliest recorded supernova, may lie in Circinus.

sections.title: Notable stars
paragraphs: [Xami](hip:71908), Alpha Circini, is a peculiar white star with a strong magnetic field, pulsating rapidly. [Beta Circini](hip:74824) and [Gamma Circini](hip:75323) complete the figure.

sections.title: Beyond the stars
paragraphs: Circinus lies in the Milky Way, toward faint clusters and nebulae.
